summary: A parallel working copy of Buckland Blocks whose agent rules define the release path: branch, focused regression tests, `npm run verify`, the Game Release Gate check, a Vercel preview Josh approves, and new features shipped off behind `?features=` flags.

props.title: Release path
steps: One small branch per change.
Add focused regression tests.
npm run verify: typecheck, lint, tests, build, headless smoke.
Open a PR and wait for the release gate.
Josh tests the Vercel preview before merge.

props.title: Feature flag
props.on: Flag on for this preview: ?features=name turns a gated feature on; features-save=1 keeps it.
props.off: Flag off — new features start off by default.

props.title: Production rule
props.q: May an agent push straight to main?
options: No — main only moves by a merged, gated PR
props.explain: Agents must not push or merge main directly; even hotfixes go through the PR gate.
